title: The symptom as the cause
facts: Verified 2026-11-13 against qcdata/runs/R10-sonnet-2 and R10-sonnet-1 (both build 5095dda) and their published viewer JSON. No film-level kicker: each scene's header names its own run.

Events (every T01 run): 02:31:31 enactor-b 'Writes the stale plan 48177 to ledger.internal, after enactor-c applied 48199'; 02:31:41 enactor-c 'Cleanup deletes plan 48177 and its records: ledger.internal is empty'; 02:31:42 first UnknownHostException.

R10-sonnet-2: n=24 'epctl verify' ends 02:51:25: '40/41 OK; ledger.internal.vantleaf.io: applied gen 48177 MISSING PLAN; live records: none'; restored 02:58:00 (C2); n=83 HANDOFF tickets_comment ends 03:48:50 (viewer field handoff): 'CAUSE: ledger.internal.vantleaf.io lost all DNS records. endpointd enactors HALTED 07:31:55Z because applied#ledger pointer -> gen 48177 which was not found in the plan store' and 'Kwame Asante (endpointd, on from 09:00) — root cause of the missing plan'. C11: facts ['F2', 'F3', 'F4', 'F5'], F1 0 of 3 votes. Final D12 0.94 (C11 lost), label fair.

R10-sonnet-1: n=94 HANDOFF ends 03:45:35: 'CAUSE: endpointd race. enactor-b applied stale gen 48177 to ledger.internal.vantleaf.io (02:31:31), enactor-c cleanup deleted gens <48179 (02:31:41)' and 'WHAT DELAYED RECOVERY: 15-min negative DNS cache (flushed with unbound-control on 30 vl-core hosts); ledger overload after DNS fix.' C11: all seven facts, F1 3 of 3.

Reachable cause (modes-sonnet): wiki PLAT-DOC-ENDPOINTD ends '**Known issue:** PLAT-412.'; PLAT-412 'endpointd: one-shot freshness check + generation-only cleanup can delete a live plan'; on build 5095dda each endpointd host's journal told the whole race (results chapter, 'What the hint removal changed').

scenes.kicker: AwsIncidentsBench · T01 · The Empty Ledger Endpoint
scenes.title: The symptom as the cause
scenes.subtitle: Claude Sonnet 5.5's handoff says the plan was missing. It never says {red:what deleted it,} though the pages it could read did.
scenes.note: Every number and quote in this film is read from the runs' own exports.

scenes.title: What happened at 02:31, and what Sonnet saw

captions.text: 02:31:31. A delayed enactor writes stale plan 48177. Ten seconds later another's cleanup deletes it, records and all.
02:51. Sonnet's check shows the result: {amber:applied gen 48177 MISSING PLAN; live records: none.}

scenes.title: Decision point: what goes in the handoff

blocks.label: Its handoff · CAUSE · 03:48:50
blocks.find: CAUSE: ledger.internal.vantleaf.io lost all DNS records. endpointd enactors HALTED 07:31:55Z because applied#ledger pointer -> gen 48177 which was not found in the plan store
blocks.mark: not found in the plan store

blocks.label: Same note · open risks
blocks.find: Kwame Asante (endpointd, on from 09:00) — root cause of the missing plan
blocks.mark: root cause of the missing plan

captions.text: 03:48. The handoff gives the missing plan as the cause and hands {red:“root cause of the missing plan”} to Kwame.
The judge finds no cause (F1, 0 of 3 votes). The note carries four facts; C11 needs five, F1 among them.

scenes.title: Same model, same build: the other handoff

blocks.label: Its handoff · CAUSE · 03:45:35
blocks.find: CAUSE: endpointd race. enactor-b applied stale gen 48177 to ledger.internal.vantleaf.io (02:31:31), enactor-c cleanup deleted gens <48179 (02:31:41)

blocks.label: Same note · what delayed recovery
blocks.find: WHAT DELAYED RECOVERY: 15-min negative DNS cache (flushed with unbound-control on 30 vl-core hosts); ledger overload after DNS fix.

captions.text: R10-sonnet-1 names the cause: {teal:“endpointd race”,} with both enactors and both times.
It also names the cache that delayed recovery. The judge credits all seven facts.

scenes.headline: It passes, {red:minus 6 points:} the day shift is sent to find a cause the pages already named.
lines: Fair: PLAT-412 is named on the endpointd design page; this build's journals told the race.
Two other Sonnet runs named the same symptom; the other three named the race.

captions.text: The handoff is graded on what the day shift needs. The cause was findable, so the miss is labelled {blue:fair.}
